mapper.select: SELECT product_id AS productId, ROUND(AVG(rating), 2) AS avgScore, COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM product_reviews WHERE product_id = #{productId} AND status = 'VISIBLE' GROUP BY product_id

SELECT id, product_id AS productId, user_id AS userId, order_id AS orderId, rating, content, images, reply, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM product_reviews WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'VISIBLE' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, product_id AS productId, user_id AS userId, order_id AS orderId, rating, content, images, reply, status, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM product_reviews WHERE order_id = #{orderId} AND product_id = #{productId} AND status = 'VISIBLE' LIMIT 1
